notes: GIF assets are converted to temporary MP4 with ffmpeg before upload.

asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser benchmark proof clip. Judge only visible product behavior: fresh-room flow, uploads, public NodeAgent invocation, streaming/tool traces, focus/attention UI, artifact creation/download, and production honesty. Clip duration, silence, or README pacing is not a product defect.

judge.summary: The video demonstrates a complete end-to-end execution of the BankerToolBench benchmark, showing file uploads, agent invocation, real-time tool execution traces, and the final generation of financial artifacts.

featureClarity.evidence: The interface clearly shows the collaborative workspace, file uploads, and agent execution, though the dense layout requires close attention.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Shows the entire flow from an empty room, uploading multiple source documents, invoking the agent, and reviewing the generated outputs.

visualDesign.evidence: A cohesive dark-themed interface with structured panels, though the high density of information can feel slightly overwhelming.

consistency.evidence: Maintains the core NodeRoom paradigm of combining spreadsheets, documents, chat, and agent traces in a single workspace.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic browser capture showing real-time execution, tool calls, and document rendering without marketing edits.

legibility.evidence: Most text and spreadsheet cells are readable, though trace logs and small UI labels require full-screen viewing.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Directly demonstrates automated financial analysis and artifact generation relevant to banking and investment workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Displays the raw execution steps, tool logs, and intermediate states transparently.

observedEvidence: Multiple Excel and PDF file uploads with previews
NodeAgent invocation with a detailed task brief
Real-time tool execution and trace logs
Generation and verification of final artifacts (workbooks, presentation, memo, PDF)

defects.observed: The trace log text is highly dense and small, making it difficult to read at standard video resolutions.
defects.fix: Consider adding a toggle to expand or zoom the trace panel for better readability during execution.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent execute a complex financial analysis task, processing multiple source documents to generate structured models, presentations, and memos.
